mapper.sql: id, code, `date`, week, red, blue, content, create_time, modify_time
mapper.insert:
insert into t_lottery_record ( code, `date`, week, red, blue, content,create_time,modify_time) values
( #{record.code}, #{record.date}, #{record.week}, #{record.red}, #{record.blue}, #{record.content}, #{record.createTime}, #{record.modifyTime} )
on duplicate key update code=values(code), `date`=values(date), week =values(week), red =values(red), blue =values(blue), content =values(content), modify_time =values(modify_time)
mapper.select: select * from t_lottery_record where id=(select MAX(id) from t_lottery_record )
